title: Auralis dialect catalog
description: Cross-platform dialect/language catalog. Dialect IDs are permanently stable. Display names, ASR prompt language, MT language and TTS language are modeled as separate fields; a dialect's ASR prompt never implies TTS voice coverage for that dialect (ttsLanguageCode=zh does not prove the dialect can be synthesized).

family.description: Dialect family group key, e.g. mandarin, wu, min.

asrLanguage.description: ASR prompt language for this dialect.

mtLanguage.description: Source language name passed to the MT stage for text transcribed from this dialect. Defaults to asrLanguage when absent (legacy consumers).

asrLanguage.description: Legacy field name kept for compatibility; for target languages this is the MT/translation target language name.

mtLanguage.description: Translation target language name; equals asrLanguage when both are present.
